Flashes brightly on impact. Toss this right under a monster's nose to blind it.

Creates a large cloud of smoke wherever it lands.
Instantly transports you back to base camp.
A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps.

How many licks does it take to find out what was in this empty barrel? Just one!

Emits a scent Felynes love. Try hitting monsters with it.
A berry that is hollow on the inside.
Non-specialized ammo. More powerful than Lv1.

Ammo that packs extra punch against monsters susceptible to Water.
Ammo that packs extra punch against monsters susceptible to Thunder.
Ammo that packs extra punch against monsters susceptible to Ice.

Ammo that restores a moderate amount of Health to the target.

Bowgun ammo used to capture monsters ensnared in traps.

Know any monsters good at fishing? Try fighting fire with fire.

A cheap pickaxe with an easily nicked blade.
A pickaxe with a reasonably strong blade.
A pickaxe tempered with steel. This one won't nick easily.
A cheap net for catching bugs. It tears easily.
A durable net for catching bugs.
An extremely durable net for catching bugs. This one is made to last.
Just what you need to cook meat. A must-have item for any hungry hunter.
A standard-sized Whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's Sharpness.
Allow you to see farther and observe from a distance.
Junk created when a combination attempt fails.
Used to attract certain monsters -- blow at your own risk. May break when used.

Full of nutrients, but indigestible in this form.
Restores a very small amount of Health, but the flavor's not too hot.

A vine of tough fibers. Woven, it is sturdy enough to hold a person's weight.

Melynxes' favorite food -- they just have to steal it.
A night-blooming flower from a special herb native to Moga. It may have healing properties.
Blazingly spicy. Sure, it'll warm you up, but it's too hot to handle on its own.
A well-known Combo material used to augment power. The deeper the blue, the better.
A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat.

This one has a very strange aroma... Edible? Only one way to find out.

A berry with a shockng hue and an overwhelming scent. Look out: it WILL stain!
Temporarily raises your Attack when ingested by improving energy flow.
Temporarily raises your Defense when ingested by hardening tissue.
A mysterious berry that cures all elemental Blights (Fire, Water, Ice, Thunder, and Dragon)
Eat this to cure Dragonblight and temporarily increase Dragon Resistance.
A nut that violently ejects its contents when struck.
A berry covered with needle-like thorns.
A berry that explodes when struck.
A trendy orange pumpkin. If left undisturbed, it can grow to gigantic proportions.
A rock with just the right heft for throwing. Tried and tested!

Crystallized microbes which are prized as an abrasive when forging weapons.

An ore still being researched. It yields even better metal than Dragonite.

A promising new ore that produces higher quality metal than Carbalite Ore.

A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can properly work with.
An ore that blazes with an all-consuming flame. Requires considerable skill to mine.
A crystal that's 100% pure. Hard enough to be used in workshop tools.
Reacts uniquely to heat. Combine with other materials to create coating for armor.
Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to increase its strength.
Fuse this high-quality Armor Sphere to existing armor to increase its strength.
An advanced Armor Sphere. Rare in Moga Village. Save it for that special upgrade.
A fish with a dorsal fin hard enough to sharpen weapons with.
A fatty, delicious fish that restores a small amount of Health when consumed.
A fish that contains sleeping agents.
A fish with jaws covered in tiny, needle-like spikes.
A fish that literally pops when it dies.
A fish that dashes itself to pieces when it dies.

A fish that explodes when it dies.
A fish that eats anything -- allowing you to sometimes get items from its stomach.
A rare fish that commands a high price, but beware its ferocity, rookies!
A fish that can induce exhaustion.
A fish that emits blue light. Its sharp body will cut you to pieces if you're not careful
The remains of an insect. You must be one hardcore collector to hang onto this!
A grasshopper with a foul odor. Make fishing lures with it；its scent drives explosive fish wild.
An unusual larva. Make fishing lures with it； its scent drives Goldenfish wild.
An insect said to live 1000 years -- but no one's lived long enough to prove it.
Boosts your natural ability to heal when eaten. It also cures poison... sometimes.
A nocturnal insect sometimes found in daylight. They emit a bright flash upon death.
Releases an electric shock when struck. Used to light rooms and start fires.
This insect's hard shell is often used as an abrasive.
Said to be the world's strongest bug. Used in forging, cooking, and more.

A rare and valuable insect that greatly assists in the bonding of metals.

A strange insect with the large jaws of a beetle and the delicate wings of a butterfly.
A handy material used to make everything from equipment to sundries.

A weathered bone. Not sturdy enough to use in forging.
An animal skull worn and weathered beyond identification.

Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder shatters them, generating shrapnel.
Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder triggers a blast with a wide radius.

A monster organ that contains a lethal toxin. Handle with extreme care.

A monster organ with tremendous freezing power.

A monster organ designed to hold and preserve copious amounts of water.
A monster organ designed to hold and preserve tremendous amounts of water.
A mysterious substance that can be culled from certain monsters.
Has the ability to amplify the effects of certain medicines.
A big, beautiful feather plucked from a Gargwa. Often used as a fashion accessory.
Infusions of powdered Kelbi Horn work wonders on tummyaches. It's a local secret!
An especially rare Kelbi Horn. Popular among traders.
A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.
A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.
A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.
A very strong shell, considering it comes such a small monster.
A sturdy part of the skill that yields, shall we say, dashing results?
As strong as it is heavy, this Rhenoplos bone is well-suited for use in crafting armor.
Firm, lustrous hide often cut into large slabs. Prized for its water-resistant properties.
Every bit as sturdy as wyvern armor in the hands of a clever craftsman.
Difficult to forge with -- the results vary depending on which surface you use.
These durable mouthparts are surprisingly difficult to carve loose.
A transparent sac cut from an Altaroth's abdomen, used to store who knows what.
The strongest fang of a fanged beast. It can pierce a monsters's shell as if it were paper.
A scale carved from a Jaggi. Not very valuable, but beginners can't be choosers.
A vividly-colored superior Jaggi scale that can be used to produce hardier equipment.
Commonly used in this region. It can be made into any number of things.
A fang similar in value to the foreign Velociprey's. Used to make bowgun ammo.
Durable, elegantly patterned hide from a Great Jaggi. Befits its position as pack leader.
The rugged hide of a strong Great Jaggi. Fewer wounds means higher quality and value.
A hook-shaped claw cut from a Great Jaggi. Just like a Jaggi claw, only much, much larger.
A hook-shaped claw cut from a Great Jaggi. Well-Sharpened from countless battles.
Proof of who's boss among Jaggi -- and now proof you are on your way as a hunter.
A white pelt carved from a Lagombi. One touch and you'll be hooked on its soft, fluffy fur.

Sticky fluid that is often found in insects after they feast.

Needle-like hair found on the Rathian's back and wings. They contain poison.
As sharp as the keenest blade. It is longer and sturdier than other spikes.

A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.

A poisonous spike found on Gold Rathians in rare circumstances. It can pierce through anything.
A Rathalos scale. Wyvern scales like this one and the harder shells are basic forging items.
An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.
A rigid Rathalos carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathalos Shell.
A robust Rathalos shell that is harder and sturdier than a carapace.

A wing that has been removed. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.
A top-grade Rathalos wing, removed in full. Such majesty befits the King of the Skies.
The severed tail of a Rathalos. It has any number of uses.
A top-grade Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are precious, and only used in select equipment.
A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.
A rare gem formed inside a Rathalos. It seems almost too nice to forge with.
A legendary Rathalos scale. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.
An Azure Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. It boasts beauty and strength.
The severed tail of an Azure Rathalos. It fetches a high price due to its rarity.
A top-grade Azure Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are prized by all and sold at high prices.
A wing that has been removed. Excellent for forging both weapons and armor.
A Silver Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Makes for a nice silver accessory.
A heavy Silver Rathalos cortex. This legendary item shines like moonlight, even in darkness.
Recent advances allow this marrow to be extracted. It ignites on air contact.
Recent advances allow this red hot organ to be removed, but it's hard to forge with.
The rigid cortex of a Diablos, both harder and sturdier than its carapace.
Tough Diablos backplate, strengthened by burning sands. An ideal material for armor.
An especially elegant Diablos horn with almost perfect shape. An extremely rare material.
A heavy Black Diablos cortex. Its weight reveals its overwhelming density and strength.
Finely honed Black Diablos backplate. Best described as black, hard, and heavy.
The teal carapace of a Zinogre. Its magnificence reveals the futility of facing the monarch.
The teal cortex of a Zinogre. The monarch's armor crushes wills with its immense power.
A pointed Zinogre horn. When carved, it can be used to grant equipment incomparable power.
A mighty Zinogre horn. None can sand before its sky-shattering, awe-inspiring power.
A sharp, high voltage Zinogre claw. Its electrified attacks are truly brutal.
The plate-covered tail of a Zinogre. It wields deadly force when swung.
A superior Zinogre tail that wields incomparable destructive power.
A Zinogre shell that stores and releases electricity. Grants a thunder god's power to gear.
A rare gem occasionally produced inside a Zinogre's body. The monarch's power swells within.
A Stygian Zinogre's terrifyingly strong tail. Said to be able to slice through solid steel.
Dragonfell Berry-loving bugs that store up Dragon energy. A Stygian Zinogre's power source
A hard Brachydios carapace. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.
The thick cortex of a Brachydios. Its stoic beauty adds strength and dignity to equipment.
An obsidian Brachydios brace. Makes especially strong armor, perhaps due to the slime mold.
A premium Brachydios brace. The slime coating may contain weird bacteria, so be careful.
The large, protruding scalp of a Brachydios, covered in an explosive green substance.
A hard and sharp scalp piece from a fierce Brachydios. Even more explosive than usual.
The explosive green substance found on Brachydios monsters. Handle with extreme care.
Highly explosive green slime found on a fierce Brachydios. Handle with extreme care.
A Brachydios arm that buried countless foolhardy hunters. It's covered in green slime.
The arm of an especially angry Brachydios. Strong and heavy, as if made of iron.
A legendary Brachydios shell. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.
A greenish-black Deviljho scale. It's not often sold, as rumors claim it brings it misfortune.
A heavy, high-quality Deviljho scale. Rumored to bring bad luck, but actually an excellent material.
Black hide that is oddly slimy and difficult to forge with.
A dangerously sharp, hooked talon. Inexperienced crafters risk serious injury.
An incredibly sharp, rigid talon. Even experienced handlers can be injured if not careful.
Removing this part of a Deviljho's skull releases an unimaginably putrid odor.
A masive tail resembling a fin. Some folks are out to collect these exclusively.
A large slab of a Deviljho's leech-like tail. Even so-called experts are shocked by it.
The symbol of a Deviljho's insatiable appetite. The strong acid corrodes all it touches.
Dark black blood characteristic of a Deviljho. It feels like it could jump up and attack at any time.
A massive, overgrown fang that can chomp through anything. Filled with pure evil.
A precious gem said to contain a Deviljho's might. Used in shady rituals.
An unsettling scale that became warped as it absorbed the malice of the Deviljho's various prey.
One of the tougher materials to get from a Jhen Mohran, and that's saying something.
A shell piece from an Arzuros's head or back. Bends willingly and is easy to forge.
A pelt carved from an Arzuros. The white portion is soft, while the blue is short and taut.
Uncannily elastic hide that retains water quite well.
A superbly colored Qurupeo feather. Nothing less than a natural work of art.
An oddly shaped beak. It's pleasant enough.
A Barroth's shell -- more often than not covered in mud, but strong either way.
This durable part of the skull is also the hardest to remove.
Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are surprised by its bright colors, in contrast to the outer shell.
A fluid which helps retain water in a Nibelsnarf and allows the beast to thrive in the desert.
Hard-to-obtain bone marrow used for special crafts as well as medicinal purposes.
Even more heat resistant than the Shell, this is said to protect sensitive organs.
The horn of a Duramboros. Wider than a man's chest；all who see it are rendered speechless.
This shell piece is dense, as one knock will tell you, and heavier than it looks.
A twisted Diablos horn in great shape. Use it to make more powerful weapons.
Fine skin from a Gobul. Said to rejuvenate the skin, and quite popular with the ladies.
A high-quality barb from a Gobul. Only stroner monsters have such well-shaped spikes.
Amber tusks sharpened by countless kills. They can smash through gigantic ice blocks.
A high-quality white pelt with a lovely texture. Nobles use it as a symbol of authority.
A superior shell found only on certain Lagiacrus. Its structure permits greater electric output.
An Agnaktor fin with an elegant dappled pattern. Aparently a popular item with collectors.
Even for monster skin, this is remarkably solid. Takes time and effort to craft.
A giant horn that was formed over ages. It evinces all weight of history.
Who knows why this organ glows, but it seems to hold incredible power.
This particular Alatreon scale grows in backwards. It is as sharp as a blade.
At times this looks like a dark abyss； at others, like the coming of first light.
A strong scale concealed by vivid plumage, grown to full maturity over many years.
A vivid feather with an elegant luster. Qurupeco with these only live in certain regions.
Thick skin from a Gobul. Too rubbery for eating, but perfect for crafting equipment.
An unusual barb from a Gobul. Only the most formidable of the breed have such precious spikes.
A superior Arzuros cortext. This highly-developed shell is a huge thorn in all hunters' sides.
A sparkling fluid with impressive water-retention ability. Improves performance and style.
A Barroth's cortex. Years worth of mud have hardened it beyond all measure.
The heavy scalp of a formidable Barroth. As hard to remove as it is durable.
A heavy Volvidon cortext. Difficult to forge with, but can produce genuinely powerful gear.
The rigid cortex of an Agnaktor. Highly heat-resistant, it produces bright red items when forged.
The solid, ice-covered cortex of a Jade Barroth. The frosty coating is surprisngly strong.
A legendary gem rarely produced inside a Duramboros's body. Elegant, though gloomy.
An especially hard Uragaan cortex. Crafting with it can be a trying task, to say the least.
A legendary Uragaan shell. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.
A legendary Nargacuga scale. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.
The ultimate specimen of Lagiacrus Scale. Special skills are required to craft with it.
A thick shell found on a select few Lagiacrus. It releases huge bolts of electricity.
A valuable azure scale found on select Lagiacrus. Said to greatly boost equipment performance.

A fine horn from an Ivory Lagiacrus. Beloved by the rich for its flawless elegance.
A highly heat-resistant Steel Uragaan scute. Its rigidity makes it hard to use in forging.
Almost too large to be called a scale. Not as hard as you might think.
